'''Ganwick Trag''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Bartender/Legends|bartender]].<ref name="Who's Who" /> In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="NEC" /> He<ref name="Who's Who" /> was employed as fellow bartender [[Bufon Taire/Legends|Bufon Taire's]] assistant<ref name="FF">{{FactFile|96|OUT 1-2|Outlander Nightclub Patrons}}</ref> at the [[Outlander Club/Legends|Outlander Club]],<ref name="ImageAttack" /> a [[Nightclub/Legends|nightclub]] and [[Gambling/Legends|gambling]] hall in the [[Uscru Entertainment District/Legends|Uscru Entertainment District]] of<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|431|Outlander Club}}</ref> the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Complete Locations">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2005)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref> [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="CSWE" /> One [[Standard day/Legends|night]]<ref name="aotc">{{Film|II}}</ref> that [[Standard year/Legends|year]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of {{Film|II}} to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].</ref> Trag was working behind the bar of the club when [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Zam Wesell/Legends|Zam Wesell]] escaped into the club, following her [[Plot to assassinate Senator Amidala/Legends|failed assassination]] of [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]]. The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] pair of [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] soon entered the nightclub to find the bounty hunter.<ref name="aotc" />

Trag was a muscular and imposing man<ref name="Who's Who" /> with light skin, [[Color/Legends|black]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]], and brown [[Eye/Legends|eyes]]. While working at the club, Trag wore a sleeveless net [[Clothing/Legends|shirt]] with black straps.<ref name="ImageAttack" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|The Outlander's imposing assistant bartender has arms like tree trunks and a face carved from granite. (Still, one can't help but wonder how Ganwick would fare if he were dropped into the Mos Eisley cantina and forced to tell a drunken Dr. Evazan that he's been cut off.)|Daniel Wallace|<ref name="Who's Who" />}}
Ganwick Trag first appeared in the [[prequel trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']],<ref name="aotc" /> which released on [[May 16]], [[2002]].<ref name="Year">''[[Star Wars Year by Year: A Visual Chronicle]]''</ref> The Outlander Club scenes including Trag, who was portrayed by uncredited<ref name="aotc" /> Australian [[Wikipedia:Actor|actor]] and former [[Wikipedia:Rugby league|rugby league]] star [[Ian Roberts]],<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://www.espn.com.au/nrl/story/_/id/32311107/rugby-league-legend-ian-roberts-tells-coming-story|text='It was the worst-kept secret': Rugby League legend Ian Roberts tells his coming out story|author=Lucie Bertoldo|date=2021-10-11|work=[[Wikipedia:ESPN|ESPN Australia]]|archivedate=20220818043629}}</ref> were shot at [[Fox Studios, Sydney]] on [[July 17]], [[2000]].<ref name="Mythmaking">''[[Mythmaking: Behind the Scenes of Attack of the Clones]]''</ref> Before Trag's film appearance, the character was first pictured in ''[[Star Wars: Attack of the Clones: The Illustrated Companion]]'', written by [[Marcus Hearn]]<ref name="Illustrated">''[[Star Wars: Attack of the Clones: The Illustrated Companion]]''</ref> and published on [[April 22]], 2002.<ref name="Amazon">{{Amazon|domain=co.uk|url=Star-Wars-Attack-Clones-Illustrated/dp/0091884780|text=Star Wars: Attack of the Clones: The Illustrated Companion}}</ref> The characters name was first revealed on [[November 12]], 2002, with the [[Image Attack]] feature on [[StarWars.com]].<ref name="ImageAttack" />

In the article "[[Who's Who in the Outlander Club: It's Ladies' Night]]," published in the [[Star Wars Insider 75|seventy-fifth issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'' magazine<ref name="Who's Who" /> on [[April 6]], [[2004]],<ref name="SW.com">{{SWArchive|url=community/fanclub/mag/news20040315.html|text=The New Face of Evil}}</ref> author [[Daniel Wallace]] compliments the character's looks and states that one would wonder how Trag would do when telling ''[[Star Wars]]'' character [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Cornelius Evazan/Legends|Cornelius Evazan]], who is in an inebriated state, that he's not allowed to have more drinks while at the [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|Mos Eisley cantina]]<ref name="Who's Who" /> on the planet [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="Complete Locations" /> Wallace additionally wrote that Trag's shirt is typical of the clothing seen at the Outlander, though it's not clear whether it's an employee uniform or if the character is only wearing it to show off his biceps.<ref name="Who's Who" />
